title: The proposed law draws sustained criticism
detail: Journalists, editors, and rights advocates warned that the proposed bill could entrench censorship and broad punitive powers over digital expression.

title: Digital Security Act is enacted
detail: Parliament adopted the law, giving the state a new legal framework for regulating online speech and digital conduct.

title: The law becomes central to digital-rights debate
detail: Public concern focused on vague offences, warrantless enforcement powers, and the law's potential use against journalists, dissidents, and ordinary users.

title: Its effects continue until replacement by the Cyber Security Act 2023
detail: The law remained a major reference point in debate over digital repression and was later replaced, but not fully politically forgotten, in 2023.
